### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/competitive-calls-cs/47790029
Selected recipients will receive up to EUR 10,000 for their contribution and benefit from technical guidance, consortium expertise, targeted mentoring and exchanges with European defence stakeholders.
Cifras anteriores en notación española (la fuente usa la coma inglesa como separador de miles): 10.000 €
